paragraphs: Rabbi Bun bar Kahana — [Bava Batra, chapter 8, halakha 8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Batra.8.8.2).

Rav Mari, son of Rav Kahana: [Bava Kamma 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.91a.5). Rabbah bar Kahana: the end of the introduction to Eichah Rabbah; Hyman identifies him as Rabbi Abba bar Kahana. Shimon bar Kahana, a Tanna: Tosefta Sheviit, chapter 4.

notes.text: The Abba initials are expanded from the connected Kahana list. The notice separately preserves Kohen in Chanina’s patronym.

The consulted [Shabbat passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.96a.2) reads Rav Hinena bar Kahana, where Hyman lists Rabbi Hanina bar Kohen. The parallel [Kahana list in Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2307&lang=en) includes Rabbi Abba bar Kahana and Rav Hinena among several distinct notices.
